thread:
oliver: starting release cut now, deploy-bot reported artifact verify failure on canary. holding promotion. :warning:

deploy-bot: VERIFY FAILED for redwood/web-frontend:2026-03-23-canary
  check: multipart etag mismatch for part 3 (expected e2f1..., got 0000...)
  status: promotion halted

priya: ugh multipart 0-byte parts again? last week we hit a similar case with TTL regen. ci-logs show a flurry of cache restores before this build.

ci-bot: CI build 3892 summary:
- cache restore: bulk restore triggered at 12:03 UTC (cache TTL regen)
- artifact upload: multipart upload initiated, part-00003 size reported 0 after PUT
- s3 response: 200 on complete-multipart but GET returned empty body for the part

ben: options: 1) reupload artifact + re-sign manifest (adds ~12m), 2) pin to last-good canary and promote to prod now (faster), 3) manual force-promote (not allowed by policy).

oliver: change window is tight (20m). Are there customer-facing releases in this window? small web config only. If we delay, customers see no change but release momentum stalls.

priya: leaning to pin to last-good and unblock. We can hotfix the artifact and push a follow-up micro-release later today. Risk: new code doesn't go out now.

ben: agree. Reupload path could fail recurrently if S3 is flaky; pin avoids risky repeated retries during change window.

infra-alert: flagging potential S3 partial-commit spike: 15 events in the last 90m (alert INFRA-S3-PARTIAL). Investigating put-object latencies.

oliver: decision: pin to redwood/web-frontend:2026-03-22-canary-good and promote. Create a follow-up task to re-run a rebuild with single-part upload fallback and backfill manifest once infra confirms stability.

priya: performing pin now.
deploy-bot: Pinning image for promotion: source redwood/web-frontend:2026-03-22-canary-good -> promoted tags: prod/2026-03-23-rc
deploy-bot: Promotion started to prod. Rolling 100% over 3 min. Smoke checks queued.

ci-bot: note: original build artifact retained in buildkite-agent/3892 for re-upload attempt.

ben: logging action items:
- infra: investigate S3 multipart commit anomaly and surface root cause (ticket INFRA-831)
- build: add single-part fallback for artifacts <200MB and retry-on-zero-byte-part logic (PR PR-4532)
- release: note in release notes: "Promotion pinned to previous canary due to transient artifact verification; follow-up hotfix scheduled."

priya: smoke tests green on prod. :white_check_mark: all good. I'm updating release notes and pushing the promote event to the release tracker.

oliver: thanks. we'll target rebuild+reupload later in the 18:00 change window if infra gives clean bill. end of thread.
